name: product_view
description: Renders memory/PRODUCT-VIEW.html from the source: the flows between primitives (an entry point nobody imports, the modules it reaches through local imports, and the paths their source names), the paths named across tools/, the gates that prove each module, and the skills with the tool they drive. One self-contained page with inline CSS, no script and no network, carrying a content fingerprint that --check compares to a fresh scan.

metadata.standaloneReason: Mechanical generator with one deterministic output and a fingerprint gate; a skill would restate the command without adding judgement.

check.description: Compare the page on disk with a fresh scan of the source; exit 1 when it is missing or stale.

stdout.description: Print the page instead of writing it.

out.description: Write the page here, resolved against the workspace root, instead of memory/PRODUCT-VIEW.html. Use .runs/<job>/view.html to leave a change the artifact a person opens.
